_comment: AUTOMATION RULES — event, condition, action. As data, so a rule can be read,
disabled or added without touching the engine.
WHAT THIS IS NOT. Not an event bus, not a queue, not a scheduler. Rules are
evaluated synchronously when a domain operation records an event, and each
action calls a DOMAIN OPERATION — never a repository, never a status field.
An automation rule has exactly the permissions an operator has, and fewer:
src/operations/automation.js refuses any action not on the allowlist.
IDEMPOTENCY IS PER RULE PER SUBJECT. `idempotencyKey` is a template; the
engine renders it and refuses to run the same rule twice for the same key.
That is what makes a redelivered event harmless.
LOOPS. `maxRuns` caps a rule per key, and the engine will not recurse more
than `cascadeDepth` levels — so an action that causes an event that fires
the same rule stops rather than spiralling.
